name: experience-hint-cache-resolve-main-root
title: Resolve the Experience Layer finding-signals cache from the main repo root so hints load during worktree-based review
description: The finding-signals cache lives only in the main checkout (.lattice/learning is gitignored), but story DEV/REVIEW runs in worktrees where loadExperienceHints(ctx.root) cannot find it — so hints never surface and experience_hint_surfaced never fires (Experience Layer operationally dormant, nOn=2). Resolve the learning-store cache root to the main repo root via git rev-parse --git-common-dir (fallback to the passed root on failure) for both read and write, so one canonical cache is reachable from every worktree. Advisory-only; no gate/schema change. + smoke.
